post.description: 使用 Pi 原生来源语义安装 npm、公共 HTTPS Git 或服务端本机目录包；先核验目录与数据区边界或远程主机。Git 拒绝内嵌凭据、文件协议与重定向。相同已安装来源回读当前结果，不重跑安装；修改版本须先卸载。仅加载 Skill，安装不等于调用。前台有 queued/running 请求或已有管理操作时返回 409 RUN_BUSY、retryAction=wait；后台媒体运行不算前台忙。成功后目录与空闲会话已刷新；不返回 command receipt、不承诺 exactly-once。响应丢失或失败时先 GET 回读，不自动重发；实际状态不可回读时如实报错，不声明回滚。

x-commands.safety: Origin required and checked; application/json for mutations; no implicit coercion/removal/defaults

exceptions.installSkillPackage: Native package mutation; no commandId or receipt, no exactly-once guarantee. Read readSkillPackages before deciding whether to retry.
exceptions.removeSkillPackage: Native package mutation; no commandId or receipt, no exactly-once guarantee. Read readSkillPackages before deciding whether to retry.

x-review-policy.startWork: title-only start_work is unchanged; optional adoptContent:ContentSourceInput pins an existing exact text revision or message explicitly adopted by the current user. Host atomically creates the work, its content review item and a new work confirmation, without copying the text artifact, reusing a standalone confirmation identity or starting production. User action source and identity are host supplied.
x-review-policy.confirmation: Exclusive unchanged work shape, kind=standalone_artifact approval, or kind=adopt_preview finalization; host supplies real user action source and preserves the exact structured action and target.
x-review-policy.continue: Only approve_and_continue queues one ordinary request; standalone_artifact only approves an exact independent script revision without creating a work or run.
x-review-policy.finalization: finalize_video targets the current final video, or atomically adopts an existing exact preview into a same-byte final video through adopt_preview; ordinary approval never finalizes or changes the source clip.
x-review-policy.librarySelections: Persist exact finalized sourceVideo and artifact_revision, project_file, or run_input source. run_input pins runId/operationId/inputIndex/blobId in the video's actual consumed inputs; coordinates alone grant no access. A confirmation command cannot also carry selections.

x-local-creation-policy.origin: local_request requestId; finance=null; no proposal, authorization or fictional bill.
x-local-creation-policy.snapshots: New snapshots are typed paid_production/local_creation; preserve old untyped paid JSON/digest.
x-local-creation-policy.project: Freeze and persist before render; project files are never public uploads or executable same-origin previews.
x-local-creation-policy.execution: render_project accepts existing RenderParameters: code_project and all four native concat branches, through the same render/Worker and per-work admission. Native outputs are video; code outputs follow declaration plus actual probe. Host-resolved musicSource is read-only and frozen before digest.
x-local-creation-policy.diagnostics: ExecutionObservation.message and Run.issue.message allow at most 9600 characters for bounded local execution output tails and exit context; no new log or event protocol.
